decisions.statement: A fable model name opens with `claude-fable-`.
A request body that is no JSON names no fable model.
A missing request body names no fable model.
The model name `claude-fable-` with nothing after names a fable model.
The prefix match is case sensitive.
A non-string `model` value names no fable model.
A body key beside `model` never refuses the parse.
Nothing here rewrites a request body.

definition: whether a request body names a fable model
